name: scenes/hero_lot.png
prompt: High-angle security camera view of a large, busy outdoor parking lot at golden hour, photographed from a pole-mounted CCTV camera about 10 meters up, slight wide-angle distortion, realistic photograph, many parked cars in neat painted rows. Exactly one parking space in the upper right third of the frame has just been vacated and is empty. Around that one empty space, a crisp thin lime-green (#C8F560) surveillance targeting frame: only the four corner brackets plus a faint thin outline, like a Person of Interest machine HUD. Directly above the frame a small solid lime-green label tag with dark text reading exactly: SPOT OPEN · TEXTED. No other text, no logos, no watermarks, no people's faces. The left half and bottom of the image are calm and uncluttered (open asphalt and rows of cars) so a headline can sit on top.
